description: Settings pages for profile, billing and team on the shared settings layout, one URL per section.

architectureNotes: Settings compose @tangle-network/agent-app/settings-react. app/settings/layout.tsx draws the title and one link per section with SettingsLayout, and each section is its own route: /settings (Profile), /settings/billing and /settings/team.

Add a section as a folder under app/settings/ plus an entry in app/settings/settings-nav.tsx. Build its cards from SettingsSection and SettingsRow in @tangle-network/ui/primitives: label on the left, one control on the right.

Low-risk fields save on change or blur through useSettingField, and the row shows Saving, Saved or the refusal with Retry. Changes that cost money, remove something or change how a person signs in (plan, cancellation, email) go through ConfirmAction.

app/settings/settings-api.ts keeps the data in memory. Replace each write with your API call, wrapped in confirmSettingResponse(fetch(...), () => next), so a row says Saved only after the server confirms and shows the server's refusal message otherwise.

Team uses MembersSection and InvitationsSection with the teams MemberView and InvitationView shapes. ExportSection, DeleteWorkspaceSection and TimezonePicker come from the same entry when the app needs them.
